plan.title: Extend Submission Time to E+30 Minutes

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ summary as the buyer; this is the required starting state for the existing event.
Open Extend Submission Time, choose Fixed, set the time 30 minutes after the current end E, and verify the new end is saved at the expected offset.
